title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Numbers 4: the duties of the Kohathites, Gershonites and Merarites in carrying the Tent of Meeting, and the census of the Levites.

questions.text: Between which ages were the sons of Kohath to be counted for service in the Tent of Meeting?
questions.explanation: Moses and Aaron were to count the sons of Kohath from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old, all who entered the service of the Tent of Meeting.

answers.text: From twenty years old and upward
From thirty to fifty years old
From twenty-five to fifty years old
From thirty to sixty years old

questions.text: When the camp moved forward, what did Aaron and his sons take down to cover the ark of the Testimony?
questions.explanation: Aaron and his sons were to take down the veil of the screen and cover the ark of the Testimony with it, then add a covering of sealskin and a blue cloth.

questions.text: After the ashes were taken away from the altar, what color of cloth was spread on it?
questions.explanation: They were to take away the ashes from the altar and spread a purple cloth on it.

questions.text: Who had to cover the sanctuary and its furniture before the sons of Kohath came to carry it?
questions.explanation: When Aaron and his sons had finished covering the sanctuary and its furniture, the sons of Kohath came to carry it, but they were not to touch the sanctuary, lest they die.

questions.text: What was the duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron?
questions.explanation: Eleazar was in charge of the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, the anointing oil, and all the tabernacle and its furnishings.

answers.text: Carrying the boards, bars and pillars of the tabernacle
The oil for the light, the sweet incense and the anointing oil
Taking down the hangings and the screen of the court
Counting the sons of Merari by their fathers' houses

questions.text: What were the Gershonites to carry?
questions.explanation: The Gershonites carried the curtains of the tabernacle, its coverings, the screen for the door, and the hangings of the court with their cords.

answers.text: The curtains of the tabernacle and the hangings of the court
The ark of the Testimony and the table of show bread
The golden altar and the lamp stand with its lamps
The fire pans, meat hooks and shovels of the altar

questions.text: Under whose hand were the duties of the Gershonites and the Merarites?
questions.explanation: The service of both the Gershonites and the Merarites was under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

questions.text: Which items were the burden of the sons of Merari?
questions.explanation: The sons of Merari carried the tabernacle's boards, bars, pillars and sockets, and the pillars of the court with their sockets, pins and cords.

answers.text: The vessels of ministry and the blue cloths
The screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting
The boards, bars, pillars and sockets of the tabernacle
The oil vessels of the lamp stand

questions.text: How many Kohathites were counted for service?
questions.explanation: Those who were counted of the Kohathites by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.

questions.text: How many Levites in total were counted for the work of the Tent of Meeting?
questions.explanation: All the Levites counted from thirty to fifty years old for the work of service and of bearing burdens were eight thousand five hundred eighty.
